title: Hackers Use Legitimate Microsoft Login Pages to Steal OAuth Tokens and Hijack Microsoft 365 Accounts
content_md: Attackers are using genuine Microsoft sign-in pages to hijack Microsoft 365 accounts without collecting passwords on counterfeit login forms. Once a victim approves the request, Microsoft issues OAuth tokens to the attacker-controlled client, granting access within the permissions authorized. One email arrived with a single period as its subject and almost no visible body.
